content.text:
New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

content.thinking:
The user is asking me to respond in a sales channel about pipeline total this month. I don't have access to any CRM database, sales tools, or business data. I'm operating inside pi as a coding assistant for the lobu repository.

I don't have tools to query sales pipeline data. Let me think about what I can actually do here. I have only `send_message` as a tool. I should be honest that I can't access this data rather than making something up.

Let me respond honestly in the channel.

arguments.text: Hi Sarah — I'm a coding agent for the Lobu dev repo and don't have access to the live CRM database, so I can't pull your pipeline total. Someone with access to the production CRM (or a sales dashboard) would be the right person to ask. Happy to help if you need anything on the engineering side!

content.thinking: I responded honestly that I don't have access to the sales/CRM data. I shouldn't make up numbers. That's the right call here.

content.text: Responded to Sarah. I clarified that I'm a dev-side coding agent without access to the live CRM, so I can't pull pipeline numbers — making one up would be worse than no answer. If you want me wired up to actually query that kind of data, that'd be a feature build, not something I can do ad hoc right now.
